claim: UNESCO declared Jana Gana Mana the best national anthem in the world
why: Classic WhatsApp forward since ~2008; false. Shows fact-checker consensus and copy-paste forwards collapsing to one voice.

claim: Seven people were killed when a truck hit a pickup van in Amravati, Maharashtra
why: Real 2 Oct 2026 accident carried as PTI wire copy by many outlets. Shows syndication collapse and an earlier 'five killed' wire version.

claim: Papaya leaf extract increases platelet count in dengue patients
why: Forwarded health remedy with genuine mixed evidence: Scholar finds supportive trials, fact-checkers push back on 'cure' framing.

claim: Gujarat became the second state after Uttarakhand to get a Uniform Civil Code after President Murmu gave assent
why: True 2 Oct 2026 news recorded live by the CLI. Several near-identical write-ups collapse; a spam scraper with a wrong date is down-weighted and never chosen as the origin.
